reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the research question's focus on high-temperature wear resistance of FeNiCrCoCu coatings by proposing a clear, testable mechanism (oxide layer formation and self-healing) with a specific intervention (oxygen-rich pre-treatment vs. inert baseline), while Hypothesis B relies on evidence from a different alloy system (CoCrFeNiMn) and introduces a less direct mechanism (microstructural refinement via vacuum heat treatment) that may not fully capture the oxidation-driven wear behavior expected in this regime.
